notes:
## New features
- Switch the active basemap directly from the 3D toolbar, beside Save Image.
- Choose Standard or Slim coordinate-neatline margins in the Sheet tab.

## Changes
- Lock View, Side Panel and Identify Receptors are available beside the preview zoom controls, with an eased lock animation.
- Calculate and Update Grid now use the standard AURIS teal.
- Receptor results show Assigned Building whenever a receptor is assigned to a building, with rows ordered by building, base receptor ID and floor.
- Single-scenario results include the selected scenario beside the time-slice levels. Building assignments are included in copied and Excel tables.
- Compact sheet defaults use an 8 pt project title and 6 pt supporting text, medium-weight values, smaller automatic logos and 50% contour swatch rounding. Existing custom sizes are retained.
- Sheet headings now read Time Slice and Contour Scale, dB.
- Scale bars use readable metric divisions and consistent units, with steadier live zoom thresholds and a clearer white outline. Settled sheet previews use supersampling for smoother overlays and small text.

## Bug fixes
- Coordinate-neatline visibility and margin choice are retained when reopening a project.
- Sheet-preview north arrows and scale bars now scale consistently from the export geometry; exported decoration sizes are unchanged.
- Copying or exporting a contour sheet no longer prompts for recalculation solely because its viewport extends beyond the calculated grid. Colour, label and presentation edits retain the calculated levels; changes to calculation inputs still prompt for an update.
